lines.zh: 我慢慢踱着，弓背在肩上。
lines.en: I pace slowly, bow on my back.

lines.zh: 高个子在海雾里显得更高。
lines.en: My tall frame looks taller in the sea fog.
I step through the shallows without pausing.

lines.zh: 我沿着岸往村子那边走。
lines.en: I head along the shore toward the village.

lines.zh: 我的披风湿透了，还在滴水。
lines.en: My cloak is soaked and still dripping.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，像早就走惯了。
lines.en: I walk steadily, as if used to this.

lines.zh: 我停在礁石上，看了一会儿。
lines.en: I stop on a rock and watch for a while.
Muscle shifts beneath my skin.
I was a pillager once.
Now I walk slower than they do.
I drag my steps, one by one.
I head toward the cooking smoke.
I pass the wreck and keep going.

lines.zh: 沙滩上留下我很深的脚印。
lines.en: My prints sink deep in the sand.

lines.zh: 我把箭袋往肩上提了提。
lines.en: I hitch my quiver higher.
I draw nearer to the village with each step.
I stand with my bow half raised.
The sea wind sways me.
I pluck the bowstring.

lines.zh: 我们不会喊叫，只会靠近。
lines.en: We do not shout; we just come closer.
I stare toward the village.
My eyes are wet.
I'm counting your steps to the wall.
I draw a slow breath.
I lift my head and sniff.

lines.zh: 我的手臂上有东西在动。
lines.en: Something moves under my arm.
I stand half a head above a man.
I ease the bowstring off.
No hurry; the village will not move.

lines.zh: 我在等潮水把我送近一点。
lines.en: I wait for the tide to bring me closer.
You are standing in the road.

lines.zh: 我的脖子像生锈一样转。
lines.en: My neck turns as if it has rusted.
You know what I used to be.

lines.zh: 现在我拉了弓也不会手抖。
lines.en: Now my hand does not shake when I draw.
You smell of the village.
I tilt my head and my neck cracks.
You're standing in the path of my arrow.
I will not eat you; I will shoot you.
You still have time to run.
I am looking at what you hold.
I grunt and give half a step.
That broke my skin.
I press the wound.
I did not cry out; I only gasp.
My bow nearly slips.
I glance at the blood.
I nock another arrow.
I press the wound shut and draw the bow full.
I shift backward.
Your face is carved into my memory.
I do not eat that.
Put down the arrow and then talk.
I sniff; the sea smell is stronger.
What you hold is too dry.
I reach out and push it aside.
I do not need your charity.
A bag of dry rations doesn't interest me.
Hold it steady; do not tremble.

lines.zh: 这东西我不吃，可我会拿走。
lines.en: I will not eat it, but I will take it.
You had better stop holding it up.
You run into me and I shove you off.
I am taller and heavier.

lines.zh: 我们擦过，你的肩撞到我的弓。
lines.en: We brush past and your shoulder hits my bow.

lines.zh: 我脚下没动，你退了两步。
lines.en: I do not move; you fall back two steps.
Move; this is not your road.

lines.zh: 我的湿衣服蹭了你一身。
lines.en: My wet clothes smear you.
The impact throws up spray.
I push your shoulder away with my bow.
My soaked cloak snagged on you.
Do not try that a second time.

lines.zh: 我们的队伍早已不成队伍。
lines.en: Our band is no band anymore.

lines.zh: 村子里没有我们这样的人。
lines.en: There is no one like us in the village.
I walk the shore alone.
The scent of kin grows fainter.
I glance at the moon.
Creatures like me have no company.
The tide will bring more.
I sling my bow.
I keep heading for the village.
The wind thins the sea fog.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起它，手是湿的。
lines.en: I bend and pick it up with wet hands.
What falls belongs to whoever gets there first.
I stuff it into my quiver.
I look; not worth an arrow.
I toss it into the water.
This is a bit heavy.
I hold it between two fingers.
I tuck it into my belt.
I pull this arrowhead out; it can fly again.
Do not come over to take it.
I raise my bow.

lines.zh: 你的胸口正中我的准星。
lines.en: Your chest sits right on my mark.
The hand that draws is steady.
It is far, but I see clearly.
I nock an arrow and hold my breath.
I begin to aim.
The arrow is already nocked.
Do not move; movement spoils the shot.
This arrow is for you.
I do not shout and I do not chase.
I adjust the angle little by little.
The more you run, the better my aim.
The first arrow is to test you.
The second will come in lower.

lines.zh: 我压低身子绕到上风口。
lines.en: I crouch and circle upwind of you.
I shift position behind a tree.
You are hiding behind a shield.
I am running short of arrows.
I wait for you to peek out.
Village walls will not stop arrows.
I swing my bow like a club.
My arrow grazes your ear.

lines.zh: 你一盾挡开，我换了角度。
lines.en: You block with your shield, so I change angle.
I shoulder you down.
This arrow lodges in your shoulder armor.
I step back and nock another.
The string cuts my finger.
You are too close for the bow.
I strike your wrist.
That should push you back.

lines.zh: 一个掠夺者沉进浪里，我站了起来。
lines.en: A pillager sinks in the waves, and I rise.
I am a head taller than before.

lines.zh: 海水从我衣服里往下淌。
lines.en: Seawater streams from my clothes.
Seawater keeps running from my cuffs.
This is still the same bow.
I take my stand on the shore.
There are lights by the village.

lines.zh: 我的第一支箭已经搭好。
lines.en: My first arrow is already nocked.
I shake the water from my cloak.
I lift my head and see smoke.

lines.zh: 火烧到我湿透的衣服，冒起白汽。
lines.en: Fire hits my soaked clothes and steam rises.

lines.zh: 我摔在礁石上，肋骨响了一下。
lines.en: I hit the rocks and a rib cracks.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的肺，我咳出咸沫。
lines.en: Water fills my lungs and I cough up brine.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻我，弓飞了出去。
lines.en: The blast throws me and my bow flies off.

lines.zh: 我以前也射过这样的箭。
lines.en: I have loosed arrows like this one before.

lines.zh: 那道光把我的弓弦烧断。
lines.en: That light burned my bowstring through.
Hunger keeps me from drawing the bow.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我僵了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits and I lock up.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下拉，我抓不住。
lines.en: The void drags me down and I cannot hold on.
